name: Ahimelech
description: High Priest living at the time of United Monarchy

points: So we see what happened: Saul accused Ahimelech and the priests of conspiracy. After that, Doeg killed 85 priests, and the city of Nob was destroyed. All because of hatred and envy.

note.label: The Inevitability of Obsolescence & Agony of Defeat

points: Here you see that Saul had placed an Edomite over his servants: Doeg the Edomite, which was set over the servants of Saul, answered and reported that David had come to Nob and that Ahimelech had inquired of the Lord for him, given him victuals, and given him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.
To the chief musician, Maschil, a Psalm of David, written when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul that David had come to the house of Ahimelech. Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man?

note.label: Psalm 52: The Boasting Man of Sin Revealed
